chosen_titles.rationale: PART I ADMINISTRATION OF THE GOVERNMENT (Chapters 1 through 182) contains M.G.L. c. 3 (General Court), which houses the legislative-agent / executive-agent lobbying-disclosure regime at sections 39-50.

notes: MA Justia uses a Part > Title > Chapter > Section tree (4 levels). 2010 vintage uses unhyphenated slugs (parti/) vs. 2015's hyphenated (part-i/). Single regime housed in Part I; no parallel executive-branch part is required.
